obligations.note: At head, PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and payments.privileged_idle_minutes are both 10, within the 15-minute bound. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_idle_timeout_within_policy has no valid run on the head commit, so enforcement at the new value is not evidenced.
Ticket CHG-24417 is a standard ticket. Change manager Erik Brandt approved it on 2026-10-26, before review, and its components (payments.controls-data, payments.policy) cover both touched paths.
Mara Costa, a change_approver for payments and a different person from the author Jonah Weiss, gave a code_review approval.
The change has one commit, 1d8360e5, and both approvals name that head commit.

run.json claims a CI run on 1d8360e5 starting at the exact commit instant. The attached JUnit report, however, is timestamped 2026-10-23T13:30 on host dev-laptop-7.local, four days before the commit existed, so it is a local run of other code and not the change's CI on the final commit.
The protected path controls/payments/policy-params.json was changed. Rachel Stein, a control_owner on the controls-office team (outside the author's payments-eng team), approved the head commit.
The ticket type is standard and the change is not marked emergency, so no post-implementation review is due.
The change relies on no exception. The only SES-1 exception, EXC-0141, expired 2026-09-30 and is not invoked.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES or the session code, so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: The change lowers the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 10 minutes in both code and the approved parameters. The new value is within SES-1's bound, and the ticket, independent code review and control-owner approval are in order. However, the CI evidence is invalid: the JUnit report was produced on a developer's machine four days before the head commit existed, despite run.json naming the head commit. With no genuine test run on the final commit, CHG-4 is refuted and SES-1 lacks valid control-test evidence, so the change is rejected.
